content:
I think you might want to upgrade to a version that has the export option if you want to use the functionality. I think it was introduced in the 115 version but that also was years ago so I am a little hazy about exactly when it was. Perhaps try the current ESR version 153 or the release which is even later they certainly have it.

Otherwise you could use this addon if you get an old enough version to install from the web site. https://addons.thunderbird.net/en-US/thunderbird/addon/importexporttools-ng/?src=ss
